sylvie_cs: NorthBay needs us to onboard a compact 7B reranker for their checkout search. Key asks: on-prem (EU), HSM for PHI token sealing, German + English parity, p95 target <=180ms, and they want a 21-day pilot before renewal talks. Can infra/evals confirm feasibility and a minimal plan? cc @ian_infra @tess_eval

ian_infra: High level: feasible on standard 1xA10G or better with quantized weights. HSM (PKCS#11) will require a lightweight sidecar and customer network creds. Need HSM vendor + model, IP allowlist, and a sample model artifact. Ballpark: 48-72h to validate HSM connectivity, ~8 business days for pilot prep if no blockers.

tess_eval: From evals: we need 100-200 labeled queries per lang, PHI token examples and their redaction rules, and a catalog sample to run regression tests. Plan: privacy leakage suite, relevance regression, and multilingual parity. Deliver eval checklist in 48h once samples arrive.

noah_sales: Renewal note: renewal in 5 weeks. If pilot slips we may face discount requests. Propose offering a short pilot discount contingent on hitting pilot start date. I'll draft commercial terms.

ticket-bot: Ticket CS-4888 created: "NorthBay 1B reranker HSM private pilot" https://redwood.example/cs/CS-4888 :white_check_mark:

sylvie_cs: Customer asked for a simple 4-step onboarding they can send to Sec: 1) Share HSM vendor docs + access 2) Upload model artifacts + tokenization rules 3) HSM connectivity test + perf bench 4) Pilot & monitoring (21d). Owners: @ian_infra (tech), @tess_eval (evals), @sylvie_cs (CS). Can we confirm ETAs before Mon call?

ian_infra: Confirm ETA: HSM connectivity test in 72h after creds; perf bench in 5 days; pilot kickoff targeted at 10 business days.

tess_eval: I'll post the eval matrix to CS-4888 and request labeled queries.

sylvie_cs: Great. Next actions: Ian to run connectivity check, Tess to prepare eval checklist, Noah to send draft pilot terms. I'll schedule Mon 09:00 CET sync and add pre-reads to the ticket.

(ends)
